title: An Approach to Automatic Summarization by Integrating Latent Dirichlet Allocation in Conditional Random Field
title_en: An Approach to Automatic Summarization by Integrating Latent Dirichlet Allocation in Conditional Random Field
title_zh: 条件随机场中集成潜在狄利克雷分配的自动摘要方法
abstract_en: In recent years,Latent Dirichlet Allocation(LDA) has been widely applied in the document clustering,the text classification,the text segmentation,and even the query based multi-document summarization without supervision.LDA is recognized for its great power in modeling a document in a semantic way.In this paper we propose a new superivised method for the extraction-based single document summarization by adding LDA of the document as new features into a CRF summarization system.We study the power of LDA and analyze its different effects by changing the number of topics.Our experiments show that,by adding LDA features,the result of traditional CRF summarization system can be impressively increased.
abstract_zh: 近年来，潜在狄利克雷分配（LDA）在文档聚类、文本分类、文本分割，甚至无监督的基于查询的多文档摘要中得到了广泛的应用。LDA因其在以语义方式对文档进行建模方面的强大功能而受到认可。本文通过将文档的LDA作为新特征添加到CRF摘要系统中，提出了一种新的基于提取的单文档摘要的有监督方法。我们研究了LDA的威力并分析了其不同的效果我们的实验表明，通过添加LDA特征，传统CRF摘要系统的结果可以得到显着提高。

title: A framework of feature selection methods for text categorization
title_en: A framework of feature selection methods for text categorization
title_zh: 文本分类的特征选择方法框架
abstract_en: In text categorization, feature selection (FS) is a strategy that aims at making text classifiers more efficient and accurate. However, when dealing with a new task, it is still difficult to quickly select a suitable one from various FS methods provided by many previous studies. In this paper, we propose a theoretic framework of FS methods based on two basic measurements: frequency measurement and ratio measurement. Then six popular FS methods are in detail discussed under this framework. Moreover, with the guidance of our theoretical analysis, we propose a novel method called weighed frequency and odds (WFO) that combines the two measurements with trained weights. The experimental results on data sets from both topic-based and sentiment classification tasks show that this new method is robust across different tasks and numbers of selected features.
abstract_zh: 在文本分类中，特征选择（FS）是一种旨在使文本分类器更加高效和准确的策略。然而，在处理一项新任务时，从许多先前研究提供的各种FS方法中快速选择合适的方法仍然很困难。在本文中，我们提出了基于两种基本测量的FS方法的理论框架：频率测量和比率测量。然后在此框架下详细讨论了六种流行的FS方法。此外，在理论分析的指导下，我们提出了一种称为加权频率和赔率（WFO）的新颖方法，它将两种测量结果与经过训练的权重结合起来。基于主题和情感分类的数据集的实验结果...

title: Two-Pass Deterministic Dependency Parsing for Long Chinese Sentences
title_en: Two-Pass Deterministic Dependency Parsing for Long Chinese Sentences
title_zh: 中文长句的两遍确定性依存分析
abstract_en: This paper proposes a two-pass parsing approach to improve the performance of deterministic dependency parser for long Chinese sentences. In the first pass, the sentence is divided by every comma, semicolon and colon to be parsed separately, and in the second pass, the built sub-trees are integrated to do a reparsing. The error propagation of the deterministic parser is effectively reduced through the two-pass parsing. The experimental results show that although neither punctuation classifier nor root finder is adopted, the proposed parser still achieves a desirable performance, especially the root accuracy.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种两遍解析方法来提高确定性依存解析器对长中文句子的性能。在第一遍中，句子被每个逗号、分号和冒号分开进行单独解析，在第二遍中，将构建的子树整合起来进行重新解析。通过两遍解析，有效减少了确定性解析器的错误传播。实验结果表明，尽管既没有采用标点分类器，也没有采用根查找器，所提出的解析器仍然达到了理想的性能，特别是根准确率。

title: Multi-domain Sentiment Classification
title_en: Multi-domain Sentiment Classification
title_zh: 多领域情感分类
abstract_en: This paper addresses a new task in sentiment classification, called multi-domain sentiment classification, that aims to improve performance through fusing training data from multiple domains. To achieve this, we propose two approaches of fusion, feature-level and classifier-level, to use training data from multiple domains simultaneously. Experimental studies show that multi-domain sentiment classification using the classifier-level approach performs much better than single domain classification (using the training data individually).
abstract_zh: 本文解决了情感分类中的一项新任务，称为多域情感分类，旨在通过融合来自多个域的训练数据来提高性能。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了两种融合方法：特征级和分类器级，以同时使用来自多个领域的训练数据。实验研究表明，使用分类器级方法的多域情感分类比单域分类（单独使用训练数据）表现得更好。

title: An efficient approach to rule redundancy reduction in hierarchical phrase-based translation
title_en: An efficient approach to rule redundancy reduction in hierarchical phrase-based translation
title_zh: 分层短语翻译中减少规则冗余的有效方法
abstract_en: Hierarchical phrase-based machine translation model is a popular syntax model that makes use of the expressive power of synchronous context-free grammars (SCFG) to address the reordering problem in statistical machine translation. The model, however, generally suffers from a great amount of redundancy in the extracted translation rules. In this paper, we re-introduce the concept of rift into the rule extraction procedure to force the rules with reordering power to concentrate on where reordering has actually happened. Our approach brings a dramatic reduction in the training time and the number of the rules, with only minor sacrifice in translation quality.
abstract_zh: 基于分层短语的机器翻译模型是一种流行的语法模型，它利用同步上下文无关语法（SCFG）的表达能力来解决统计机器翻译中的重新排序问题。然而，该模型通常在提取的翻译规则中存在大量冗余。在本文中，我们将裂缝的概念重新引入规则提取过程中，以迫使具有重新排序能力的规则集中在实际发生重新排序的位置。我们的方法大大减少了训练时间和规则数量，而只牺牲了很小的翻译质量。

title: A Generalized Reordering Model for Phrase-Based Statistical Machine Translation
title_en: A Generalized Reordering Model for Phrase-Based Statistical Machine Translation
title_zh: 基于短语的统计机器翻译的广义重排序模型
abstract_en: Phrase-based translation models are widely studied in statistical machine translation (SMT). However, the existing phrase-based translation models either can not deal with non-contiguous phrases or reorder phrases only by the rules without an effective reordering model. In this paper, we propose a generalized reordering model (GREM) for phrase-based statistical machine translation, which is not only able to capture the knowledge on the local and global reordering of phrases, but also is able to obtain some capabilities of phrasal generalization by using non-contiguous phrases. The experimental results have indicated that our model outperforms MEBTG (enhanced BTG with a maximum entropy-based reordering model) and HPTM (hierarchical phrase-based translation model) by improvement of 1.54 % and 0.66 % in BLEU.

title: Word Alignment Based on Multi-Grain Model
title_en: Word Alignment Based on Multi-Grain Model
title_zh: 基于多粒度模型的词对齐
abstract_en: Word alignment plays a critical role in statistical machine translation (SMT) and cross-language information retrieval. Until now, most existing methods get the word alignment within the whole range of the sentence length. The alignment quality is unsatisfactory. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to word alignment based on multi-grain model (WAMG). We split a parallel sentence pair into blocks in different grain and get the word alignments within each corresponding block. Our approach is able to restrict the search space of word alignment in the relatively accurate local range and reduce the mapping error. The experiments have shown that our approach outperforms the traditional word alignment algorithm relatively by about 12% in AER and improves the performance of Chinese-to-English translation system relatively by about 2.8% in BLEU.
abstract_zh: 词对齐在统计机器翻译（SMT）和跨语言信息检索中起着至关重要的作用。到目前为止，大多数现有方法都在整个句子长度范围内获得单词对齐。对准质量不令人满意。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于多粒度模型（WAMG）的词对齐新方法。我们将一个平行句子对分成不同粒度的块，并获得每个相应块内的单词对齐。我们的方法能够将词对齐的搜索空间限制在相对准确的局部范围内，并减少映射误差。实验表明，我们的方法在 AE 中相对传统的单词对齐算法优于传统的单词对齐算法约 12%...

title: A Structure-Based Model for Chinese Organization Name Translation
title_en: A Structure-Based Model for Chinese Organization Name Translation
title_zh: 基于结构的中文组织名称翻译模型
venue: ACM Trans. Asian Lang. Inf. Process.
abstract_en: Named entity (NE) translation is a fundamental task in multilingual natural language processing. The performance of a machine translation system depends heavily on precise translation of the inclusive NEs. Furthermore, organization name (ON) is the most complex NE for translation among all the NEs. In this article, the structure formulation of ONs is investigated and a hierarchical structure-based ON translation model for Chinese-to-English translation system is presented. First, the model performs ON chunking; then both the translation of words within chunks and the process of chunk-reordering are achieved by synchronous context-free grammar (CFG). The CFG rules are extracted from bilingual ON pairs in a training program. The main contributions of this article are: (1) defining appropriate chunk-units for analyzing the internal structure of Chinese ONs; (2) making the chunk-based ON translation feasible and flexible via a hierarchical CFG derivation; and (3) proposing a training architecture to automatically learn the synchronous CFG for constructing ONs with chunk-units from aligned bilingual ON pairs. The experiments show that the proposed approach translates the Chinese ONs into English with an accuracy of 93.75% and significantly improves the performance of a baseline statistical machine translation (SMT) system.
abstract_zh: 命名实体（NE）翻译是多语言自然语言处理中的一项基本任务。机器翻译系统的性能在很大程度上取决于包容性NE的精确翻译。此外，组织名称（ON）是所有网元中翻译最复杂的网元。本文研究了 ON 的结构表述，并提出了一种用于汉英翻译系统的基于层次结构的 ON 翻译模型。首先，模型执行ON分块；那么块内单词的翻译和块重新排序的过程都是通过同步上下文无关语法（CFG）来实现的。 CFG 规则是从训练程序中的双语 ON 对中提取的。主要贡献...

title: Sentence Type Based Reordering Model for Statistical Machine Translation
title_en: Sentence Type Based Reordering Model for Statistical Machine Translation
title_zh: 基于句子类型的统计机器翻译重排序模型
abstract_en: Many reordering approaches have been proposed for the statistical machine translation (SMT) system.However, the information about the type of source sentence is ignored in the previous works.In this paper, we propose a group of novel reordering models based on the source sentence type for Chinese-to-English translation.In our approach, an SVM-based classifier is employed to classify the given Chinese sentences into three types: special interrogative sentences, other interrogative sentences, and non-question sentences.The different reordering models are developed oriented to the different sentence types.Our experiments show that the novel reordering models have obtained an improvement of more than 2.65% in BLEU for a phrase-based spoken language translation system.

title: Multi-domain adaptation for sentiment classification: Using multiple classifier combining methods
title_en: Multi-domain adaptation for sentiment classification: Using multiple classifier combining methods
title_zh: 情感分类的多域适应：使用多个分类器组合方法
abstract_en: Sentiment classification is very domain-specific and good domain adaptation methods, when the training and testing data are drawn from different domains, are sorely needed. In this paper, we address a new approach to domain adaptation for sentiment classification in which classifiers are adapted for a specific domain with training data from multiple source domains. We call this new approach dasiamulti-domain adaptationpsila and present a multiple classifier system (MCS) framework to describe and understand it. Under this framework, we propose a new combining method, called Multi-label Consensus Training (MCT), to combine the base classifiers for selecting dasiaautomatically-labeledpsila samples from unlabeled data in the target domain. The experimental results for sentiment classification show that multi-domain adaptation using this method improves adaptation performance.

title: Predicting and Tagging Dialog-Act Using MDP and SVM
title_en: Predicting and Tagging Dialog-Act Using MDP and SVM
title_zh: 使用 MDP 和 SVM 预测和标记对话行为
abstract_en: Dialog-act tagging is one of the hot topics in processing human-human conversation. In this paper, we introduce a novel model to predict and tag the dialog-act, in which Markov decision process (MDP) is utilized to predict the dialog-act sequence instead of using traditional dialog-act based n-gram, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) is employed to classify the dialog-act for each utterance. The predicting result of MDP and the classifying result of SVM are integrated as the final tagging. The experimental results have shown that our approach outperforms the traditional method.
abstract_zh: 对话行为标记是处理人与人对话的热门话题之一。在本文中，我们介绍了一种预测和标记对话行为的新模型，其中利用马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）来预测对话行为序列，而不是使用传统的基于n-gram的对话行为，并采用支持向量机（SVM）对每个话语的对话行为进行分类。将MDP的预测结果和SVM的分类结果综合起来作为最终的标注。实验结果表明我们的方法优于传统方法。

title: Domain Adaptation for Statistical Machine Translation with Domain Dictionary and Monolingual Corpora
title_en: Domain Adaptation for Statistical Machine Translation with Domain Dictionary and Monolingual Corpora
title_zh: 使用领域词典和单语语料库进行统计机器翻译的领域适应
abstract_en: Statistical machine translation systems are usually trained on large amounts of bilingual text and monolingual text. In this paper, we propose a method to perform domain adaptation for statistical machine translation, where in-domain bilingual corpora do not exist. This method first uses out-of-domain corpora to train a baseline system and then uses in-domain translation dictionaries and in-domain monolingual corpora to improve the in-domain performance. We propose an algorithm to combine these different resources in a unified framework. Experimental results indicate that our method achieves absolute improvements of 8.16 and 3.36 BLEU scores on Chinese to English translation and English to French translation respectively, as compared with the baselines using only out-of-domain corpora.
abstract_zh: 统计机器翻译系统通常接受大量双语文本和单语文本的训练。在本文中，我们提出了一种对统计机器翻译执行域适应的方法，其中域内双语语料库不存在。该方法首先使用域外语料库训练基线系统，然后使用域内翻译词典和域内单语语料库来提高域内性能。我们提出了一种算法，将这些不同的资源组合在一个统一的框架中。实验结果表明，与传统方法相比，我们的方法在中英翻译和英法翻译上分别实现了 8.16 和 3.36 BLEU 分数的绝对提高。

title: Word Reordering Alignment for Combination of Statistical Machine Translation Systems
title_en: Word Reordering Alignment for Combination of Statistical Machine Translation Systems
title_zh: 统计机器翻译系统组合的词重排序对齐
abstract_en: Word alignment is a basic and critical process in the Statistical Machine Translation (SMT). The previous work on word alignment mainly focuses on the training process to get the word mapping relation between the source sentences and target sentences. However, the word alignment for combination of SMT system outputs is also important, which aims to find the word correspondence between alternative translation hypotheses of a source language sentence. Unfortunately, it does not attract so much attention in SMT research. In this paper, we propose a novel word alignment approach to effectively address the word alignment between sentences with different valid word orders, which changes the order of the word sequences (called word reordering) of the output hypotheses to make the word order more exactly match the alignment reference. We present experimental results on the IWSLT'2008 challenge tasks with the combination of four state-of-the-art SMT systems outputs. The results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of the system combination.
abstract_zh: 词对齐是统计机器翻译（SMT）中的一个基本且关键的过程。之前关于词对齐的工作主要集中在训练过程中以获得源句子和目标句子之间的词映射关系。然而，SMT系统输出组合的单词对齐也很重要，其目的是找到源语言句子的替代翻译假设之间的单词对应关系。不幸的是，它在SMT研究中并没有引起如此多的关注。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的单词对齐方法，可以有效地解决具有不同有效词序的句子之间的单词对齐，这改变了...的单词序列的顺序（称为单词重新排序）。

title: A New Approach to Automatic Document Summarization
title_en: A New Approach to Automatic Document Summarization
title_zh: 自动文档摘要的新方法
abstract_en: In this paper we propose a new approach based on Sequence Segmentation Models (SSM) to the extractive document summa-rization, in which summarizing is regarded as a segment labeling problem. Comparing with the previous work, the difference of our approach is that the employed features are obtained not only from the sentence level, but also from the segment level. In our approach, the semi-Markov CRF model is employed for segment labeling. The pre-liminary experiments have shown that the approach does outperform all other tradi-tional supervised and unsupervised ap-proaches to document summarization. 1
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于序列分割模型（SSM）的提取文档摘要的新方法，其中摘要被视为片段标记问题。与之前的工作相比，我们的方法的不同之处在于，所使用的特征不仅是从句子级别获得的，而且是从段级别获得的。在我们的方法中，半马尔可夫 CRF 模型用于分段标记。初步实验表明，该方法确实优于所有其他传统的有监督和无监督的文档摘要方法。 1

title: Sentiment Classification through Combining Classifiers with Multiple Feature Sets
title_en: Sentiment Classification through Combining Classifiers with Multiple Feature Sets
title_zh: 通过组合分类器与多个特征集进行情感分类
venue: International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Engineering (NLPKE)
abstract_en: Sentiment classification aims at assigning a document to a predefined category according to the polarity of its subjective information (e.g. 'thumbs up' or 'thumbs down'). In this paper, we present a classifier combination approach to this task. First, different classifiers are generated through training the review data with different features: unigram and some POS features. Then, classifier selection method is used to select a part of the classifiers for the next-step combination. Finally, these selected classifiers are combined using several combining rules. The experimental results show that all the combination approaches with different combining rules outperform individual classifiers and the sum rule achieves the best performance with an improvement of 2.56% over the best individual classifier.
abstract_zh: 情感分类的目的是根据文档的主观信息的极性（例如“竖起大拇指”或“竖起大拇指”）将文档分配到预定义的类别。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于此任务的分类器组合方法。首先，通过训练具有不同特征的评论数据来生成不同的分类器：unigram 和一些 POS 特征。然后，采用分类器选择方法选择部分分类器进行下一步组合。最后，使用多个组合规则组合这些选定的分类器。实验结果表明，所有具有不同组合规则的组合方法都优于单个分类器，并且总和规则实现了最佳性能......

title: An Effective Framework For Chinese Syntactic Parsing
title_en: An Effective Framework For Chinese Syntactic Parsing
title_zh: 一种有效的汉语句法分析框架
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
abstract_en: This paper presents an effective framework for Chinesesyntactic parsing, which includes two parts. The first one is a parsing framework, which is based on an improved bottom-up chart parsingalgorithm, and integrates the idea of the beam search strategy of N bestalgorithm and heuristic function of A* algorithm for pruning, then get multiple parsing trees. The second is a novel evaluation model, which integrates contextual and partial lexical information into traditional PCFG model and defines a new score function. Using this model, the tree with the highest score is found out as the best parsing tree. Finally,the contrasting experiment results are given. Keywords?syntactic parsing, PCFG, pruning, evaluation model.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个有效的中文句法分析框架，包括两个部分。第一个是解析框架，基于改进的自下而上的图解析算法，融合N个最佳算法的波束搜索策略思想和A*算法的启发式剪枝功能，得到多棵解析树。第二个是新颖的评估模型，它将上下文和部分词汇信息集成到传统的PCFG模型中，并定义了新的评分函数。使用该模型，找出得分最高的树作为最佳解析树。最后给出了对比实验结果。关键词：句法分析、PCFG、剪枝、评估模型。

title: Experiments for Various Alignment Models in Chinese-to-English SMT
title_en: Experiments for Various Alignment Models in Chinese-to-English SMT
title_zh: 汉英SMT中各种对齐模型的实验
venue: International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Engineering (NLPKE)
abstract_en: In this paper we analyze and compare three basic word alignment models to acquire the useful knowledge and parameters for the statistical machine translation. A series of experiments are made and a very detailed analysis based on the experiments is given. According to the different features of the three models, the merits and demerits of the models are described and analyzed respectively. Finally, the word alignment probabilities and the phrases extracted using HMM Viterbi-alignment are used to develop the Chinese-to-English statistical machine translation system. The experimental results show that the translation quality will be increased with the preprocessing of the training data, joining of the dictionary and enlarging the translation grain appropriately.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们分析和比较了三种基本的词对齐模型，以获得统计机器翻译的有用知识和参数。进行了一系列实验，并根据实验给出了非常详细的分析。根据三种模型的不同特点，分别描述和分析了三种模型的优缺点。最后，使用HMM维特比对齐提取的单词对齐概率和短语来开发汉英统计机器翻译系统。实验结果表明，通过训练数据的预处理、词典的加入以及扩大翻译范围，可以提高翻译质量。

title: A Hybrid Approach to Chinese Base Noun Phrase Chunking
title_en: A Hybrid Approach to Chinese Base Noun Phrase Chunking
title_zh: 汉语基本名词短语组块的混合方法
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a hybrid approach to chunking Chinese base noun phrases (base NPs), which combines SVM (Support Vector Machine) model and CRF (Conditional Random Field) model. In order to compare the result respectively from two chunkers, we use the discriminative post-processing method, whose measure criterion is the conditional probability generated from the CRF chunker. With respect to the special structures of Chinese base NP and complete analyses of the first two results, we also customize some appropriate grammar rules to avoid ambiguities and prune errors. According to our overall experiments, the method achieves a higher accuracy in the final results. 1
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种对中文基本名词短语（基本NP）进行分块的混合方法，该方法结合了SVM（支持向量机）模型和CRF（条件随机场）模型。为了比较两个分块器的结果，我们使用判别后处理方法，其衡量标准是 CRF 分块器生成的条件概率。针对中文基础NP的特殊结构以及对前两个结果的完整分析，我们还定制了一些合适的语法规则以避免歧义和剪枝错误。根据我们的总体实验，该方法在最终结果中取得了较高的准确性。 1

title: A New Approach to Feature Selection for Text Categorization
title_en: A New Approach to Feature Selection for Text Categorization
title_zh: 文本分类特征选择的新方法
venue: International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Engineering (NLPKE)
abstract_en: Text categorization (TC) is a problem of assigning a document into predefined classes. One of the most important issues in TC is feature selection. In this paper, we propose a new approach in feature selection called Strong Class Information Words (SCIW). Different from many existing feature selection methods, our method takes many kinds of information into account. Moreover, the method can easily use some implicit regularities of natural language. Our extensive experiments resulted in a good performance on precision by a linear classifier using SCIW feature selection method. The most attractive aspect of the classifier as a combining part in the categorization system is shown in our experiments and the combining system outperforms performances in comparison with conventional classifiers.
abstract_zh: 文本分类（TC）是将文档分配到预定义类别的问题。 TC 中最重要的问题之一是特征选择。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的特征选择方法，称为强类信息词（SCIW）。与许多现有的特征选择方法不同，我们的方法考虑了多种信息。而且，该方法可以很容易地利用自然语言的一些隐含规律。我们进行了大量的实验，使用 SCIW 特征选择方法的线性分类器在精度方面取得了良好的性能。我们的实验显示了分类器作为分类系统中的组合部分最有吸引力的方面，并且组合系统的性能优于...

title: An approach to automatic acquisition of translation templates based on phrase structure extraction and alignment
title_en: An approach to automatic acquisition of translation templates based on phrase structure extraction and alignment
title_zh: 一种基于短语结构提取与对齐的翻译模板自动获取方法
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a new approach for automatically acquiring translation templates from unannotated bilingual spoken language corpora. Two basic algorithms are adopted: a grammar induction algorithm, and an alignment algorithm using bracketing transduction grammar. The approach is unsupervised, statistical, and data-driven, and employs no parsing procedure. The acquisition procedure consists of two steps. First, semantic groups and phrase structure groups are extracted from both the source language and the target language. Second, an alignment algorithm based on bracketing transduction grammar aligns the phrase structure groups. The aligned phrase structure groups are post-processed, yielding translation templates. Preliminary experimental results show that the algorithm is effective.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种从未注释的双语口语语料库中自动获取翻译模板的新方法。采用两种基本算法：语法归纳算法和使用括号转导语法的对齐算法。该方法是无监督的、统计的、数据驱动的，并且不采用解析过程。采集过程由两个步骤组成。首先，从源语言和目标语言中提取语义组和短语结构组。其次，基于括号转导语法的对齐算法对齐短语结构组。对齐的短语结构组经过后处理，产生翻译模板。初步实验...

title: NLPR translation system for IWSLT 2006 evaluation campaign
title_en: NLPR translation system for IWSLT 2006 evaluation campaign
title_zh: IWSLT 2006 评估活动的 NLPR 翻译系统
abstract_en: In this paper we describe a hybrid approach to Chinese-to-English spoken language translation system used for the IWSLT 2006 evaluation campaign. In this system, the phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) engine is combined with the template-based machine translation (TBMT) engine and a simple way is proposed to select the best translation from the results generated by the two translation engines. The experiments prove that the combination can improve the performance of translation system. As the input sentences are speech recognition results and have no punctuation information, we restore the punctuation in source sentences in the processing and post-processing. 1.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们描述了用于 IWSLT 2006 评估活动的汉英口语翻译系统的混合方法。在该系统中，基于短语的统计机器翻译（SMT）引擎与基于模板的机器翻译（TBMT）引擎相结合，并提出了一种简单的方法来从两个翻译引擎生成的结果中选择最佳翻译。实验证明这种组合可以提高翻译系统的性能。由于输入句子是语音识别结果，没有标点符号信息，因此我们在处理和后处理中恢复源句子中的标点符号。 1.

title: The CASIA phrase-based machine translation system
title_en: The CASIA phrase-based machine translation system
title_zh: 基于短语的 CASIA 机器翻译系统
abstract_en: In this paper we propose a phrase-based translation system. In the system, we use phrase translation model instead of word-based model. An improved method of computing phrase translation probability is studied. We translate numeral phrases first by using a standard templates depository. We develop a phrase-based decoder that employs a beam search algorithm. To make the result more reasonable, we apply those words with fertility probability of zero. We improve the previously proposed tracing back algorithm to get the best path. Some experiments concerned are presented. 1
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于短语的翻译系统。在系统中，我们使用短语翻译模型而不是基于单词的模型。研究了一种计算短语翻译概率的改进方法。我们首先使用标准模板存储库翻译数字短语。我们开发了一种基于短语的解码器，采用波束搜索算法。为了使结果更加合理，我们应用生育概率为零的词语。我们改进了先前提出的回溯算法以获得最佳路径。介绍了一些相关的实验。 1

title: A Hierarchical Parsing Approach with Punctuation Processing for Long Chinese Sentences
title_en: A Hierarchical Parsing Approach with Punctuation Processing for Long Chinese Sentences
title_zh: 一种带有标点处理的汉语长句层次分析方法
abstract_en: In this paper, the usage and function of Chinese punctuations are studied in syntactic parsing and a new hierarchical approach is proposed for parsing long Chinese sentences. It differentiates from most of the previous approaches mainly in two aspects. Firstly, Chinese punctuations are classified as ‘divide ’ punctuations and ‘ordinary ’ ones. Long sentences which include ‘divide ’ punctuations are broken into suitable units, so the parsing will be carried out in two stages. This ‘divide-and-rule ’ strategy greatly reduces the difficulty of acquiring the boundaries of sub-sentences and syntactic structures of sub-sentences or phrases simultaneously in once-level parsing strategy of previous approaches. Secondly, a grammar rules system including all punctuations and probability distribution is built to be used in parsing and disambiguating. Experiments show that our approach can significantly reduce the time consumption and numbers of ambiguous edges of traditional methods, and also improve the accuracy and recall when parsing long Chinese sentences. 1

venue: International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Engineering (NLPKE)
abstract_en: We propose a new approach which can semiautomatically acquire translation templates from the unannotated Chinese spoken language corpora in the domain of travel information accessing. In the approach, we introduce two elements into the unsupervised agglomerative clustering method, which are called extended contexts and cohesion degree. With these two elements, the similarity and the degree of cohesion of two entities in the corpora may be described more exactly. In our approach the semantic and phrasal structures are firstly acquired from the unannotated corpus, and then the translation templates are manually built based on the semantic and phrasal structures. The preliminary results of our experiment show that the approach can get a higher performance than the method merely using the local contexts and mutual information.

title: The technical analysis on translation templates
title_en: The technical analysis on translation templates
title_zh: 翻译模板的技术分析
abstract_en: There have been many researches on translation templates. Translation templates are the generalization of the bilingual aligned examples, and are bilingual translation pair in which the corresponding words stems, morphemes, words, strings of words, or phrases may be replaced by variables. This work reviews the various research efforts about translation templates, brings forward three methods of templates acquisition, introduces the main process of template-based machine translation, analyzes the related techniques that need to effectively solved, sums up the research actuality of translation templates, analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of templates technology, and deduces future enhancements for translation templates.
abstract_zh: 关于翻译模板已有很多研究。翻译模板是双语对齐示例的概括，是双语翻译对，其中对应的词干、词素、单词、词串或短语可以被变量替换。本文回顾了翻译模板的各种研究成果，提出了三种模板获取方法，介绍了基于模板的机器翻译的主要流程，分析了需要有效解决的相关技术，总结了翻译模板的研究现状，分析了模板技术的优缺点，并展望了翻译模板的未来改进。

title: Approach to interchange-format based Chinese generation
title_en: Approach to interchange-format based Chinese generation
title_zh: 基于交换格式的中文生成方法
abstract_en: Interlingua-based machine translation is an important approach to implement multi-lingual speech-to-speech (S2S) translation. The natural language generation (NLG) is one of the key components in the interlingua-based machine translation systems. This paper introduces our approach to Chinese generation based on the Interchange Format (IF) developed by the C-STAR organization. In our approach, the hybrid method of feature-based deep generation method and template-based method are employed. The deep generator ensures that the generation component possesses the merits of flexibility and domain portability. The template-based generator makes the system more efficient. We also introduce another simplified Chinese generator applied in specific domain. The experimented results show that our approach is effective and practical for the natural language generation in the Interchange-Format (IF) based S2S translation system. 1.

title: Example-based Chinese-English MT
title_en: Example-based Chinese-English MT
title_zh: 基于实例的汉英机器翻译
abstract_en: Chinese sentences are translated into English sentences using example-based machine translation. The main process of example-based machine translation is divided into three phases. First, find the most similar examples as the input sentence. Then, recombine the translation of the input sentence according to most similar example and bilingual dictionary. Lastly, produce the translation of the input sentence. The main resources are bilingual dictionary, thesaurus, the standard template system and bilingual sentence aligned corpora. The bilingual dictionary, thesaurus, and the standard template system are used to calculate the similarities between two words, two chunks, and two sentences. At the same time, bilingual dictionary and bilingual sentence aligned corpora are used to adjust and produce the translation. Future improvement is given.
abstract_zh: 使用基于示例的机器翻译将中文句子翻译成英文句子。基于实例的机器翻译的主要过程分为三个阶段。首先，找到与输入句子最相似的例子。然后，根据最相似的例子和双语词典重新组合输入句子的翻译。最后，生成输入句子的翻译。主要资源有双语词典、词库、标准模板系统和双语句对齐语料库。使用双语词典、词库和标准模板系统来计算两个单词、两个词块和两个句子之间的相似度。同时，双语词典和双语搜索...

abstract_en: We describe here the three main platforms in the ERIM family of Web-based environments for human interpreting, two of them in more details, ERIM-Interp and ERIM-Collect, then ERIM-Aid.Each platform supports an aspect of the collecting or study of spontaneous bilingual dialogues, translated by an interpreter.ERIM-Interp is the core environment, providing mediated communication between speakers and human interpreters over the network.Using ERIM-Collect, French-Chinese interpreting data have been collected within the 3-year "ChinFaDial" project supported by LIAMA, a French-Chinese laboratory in Beijing.These "raw" speech data will be made available in the spring of 2004 on an open-access basis, using the DistribDial server, on a CLIPS-GETA website.Our goal is to extend such corpora, on a collaborative scheme, to allow other research groups to contribute to the site whatever annotations they may have created, and to share them under the same conditions (GPL).An ERIM-Aid variant is intended to provide focused machine aids to Web-based human interpreters, or to monolingual distant speakers conversing in different languages.

title: Bilingual chunk alignment in statistical machine translation
title_en: Bilingual chunk alignment in statistical machine translation
title_zh: 统计机器翻译中的双语块对齐
abstract_en: In this paper a new algorithm called multilayer filtering (MLF) is proposed for extracting bilingual alignment chunks automatically from a Chinese-English parallel corpus. Multiple layers are used to extract bilingual chunks according to different features of chunks in the bilingual corpus. And the alignment chunks are one-to-one corresponding with each other. The chunking and alignment algorithm doesn't rely on the information from tagging, parsing, syntax analyzing or segmenting for Chinese corpus as most conventional algorithms do. Preliminary experimental results show that the algorithm achieves a good performance in chunking and alignment. Moreover, the translations generated by this algorithm are much better than the results generated by the baseline (word-based statistical machine translation).

title: A new weighting algorithm for linear classifier
title_en: A new weighting algorithm for linear classifier
title_zh: 一种新的线性分类器加权算法
venue: International Conference on Natural Language Processing and Knowledge Engineering (NLPKE)
abstract_en: In the domain of text categorization (TC), the TF (term frequency)* IDF (inverse document frequency) weighting algorithm and TF*IWF*IWF weighting algorithm are widely used. However, the two algorithms are too biased by the term frequency and neglect the imbalance between classes. In this paper, we propose a new weighting algorithm, which is named as TF (term frequency)*IWF (inverse word frequency)*IWF (inverse word frequency)*VE (variance and expectation). The new algorithm improves the TF*IWF*IWF weighting algorithm in both TF and VE. This paper compares the new algorithm with TF*IWF*IWF algorithm respectively in theory and experiment. From the preliminary experiment, we find that the F1-measure has been improved for 11.78%.
abstract_zh: 在文本分类（TC）领域，广泛使用TF（词频）*IDF（逆文档频率）加权算法和TF*IWF*IWF加权算法。然而，这两种算法都过于偏向于词频，并且忽略了类之间的不平衡。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的加权算法，命名为TF（词频）*IWF（逆词频）*IWF（逆词频）*VE（方差和期望）。新算法改进了TF和VE中的TF*IWF*IWF加权算法。本文分别对新算法与TF*IWF*IWF算法进行了理论和实验比较。从初步实验来看，我们发现F1-measure提高了11.78%。

title: Automatic evaluation of sentence fluency
title_en: Automatic evaluation of sentence fluency
title_zh: 句子流畅度自动评估
abstract_en: In the machine translation (MT) system, how to evaluate the sentence fluency of the translation results is an important research topic. Most of the current methods are based on the similarity of output words compared with the reference translations, which don't specially address the evaluation of the sentence fluency according to the syntactic structure. This paper proposes a statistical approach to the problem, which is based on the n-gram language model and reference-independent. Our approach is a beneficial compensation to the reference-dependent methods and has better robustness than those methods based on the syntactic analysis. The preliminary experimental results indicate that the approach basically reflects the reality of human's judgment.
abstract_zh: 在机器翻译（MT）系统中，如何评估翻译结果的句子流畅性是一个重要的研究课题。目前的方法大多基于输出词与参考译文的相似度，没有专门解决根据句法结构评估句子流畅性的问题。本文提出了一种基于 n -gram 语言模型且与参考无关的统计方法来解决该问题。我们的方法是对参考依赖方法的有益补偿，并且比基于句法分析的方法具有更好的鲁棒性。初步实验结果表明，该方法基本反映了人类判断的现实情况。

title_zh: 使用基于双向 N-gram 和最大熵的组合方法进行话语分割
abstract_en: This paper proposes a new approach to segmentation of utterances into sentences using a new linguistic model based upon Maximum-entropy-weighted Bi-directional N-grams. The usual N-gram algorithm searches for sentence boundaries in a text from left to right only. Thus a candidate sentence boundary in the text is evaluated mainly with respect to its left context, without fully considering its right context. Using this approach, utterances are often divided into incomplete sentences or fragments. In order to make use of both the right and left contexts of candidate sentence boundaries, we propose a new linguistic modeling approach based on Maximum-entropy-weighted Bi-directional N-grams. Experimental results indicate that the new approach significantly outperforms the usual N-gram algorithm for segmenting both Chinese and English utterances.

title: Rule base combined linguistics knowledge with corpus
title_en: Rule base combined linguistics knowledge with corpus
title_zh: 语言学知识与语料库相结合的规则库
abstract_en: This paper proposes a new approach to construction of rule bases for the transferred-based machine translation. In our approach, the rule bases are constructed in combination of the linguistics knowledge and large scale of corpora. On the one hand, the lexical knowledge, the syntactic knowledge and the semantic knowledge are all used in the rules. On the other hand, the knowledge is used for the statistics and self-learning rules. In each rule base, all rules are scored and ranked. Thus, an impersonal choice for the sentence can be made. The preliminary experimental results show that the approach may increase the speed to build the rule base and improve the quality of rules.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种为基于迁移的机器翻译构建规则库的新方法。在我们的方法中，规则库是结合语言学知识和大规模语料库构建的。一方面，规则中用到了词汇知识、句 法知识和语义知识。另一方面，这些知识用于统计和自学习规则。在每个规则库中，所有规则都被评分和排名。因此，可以对句子做出客观的选择。初步实验结果表明，该方法可以提高规则库的构建速度，提高规则的质量。

title: Interactive Chinese-to-English Speech Translation Based on Dialogue Management
title_en: Interactive Chinese-to-English Speech Translation Based on Dialogue Management
title_zh: 基于对话管理的交互式汉英语音翻译
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel paradigm for the Chinese-to-English speech-to-speech (S2S) translation, which is interactive under the guidance of dialogue management. In this approach, the input utterance is first pre-processed and then serially translated by the template-based translator and the inter-lingua based translator. The dialogue management mechanism (DMM) is employed to supervise the interactive analysis for disambiguation of the input. The interaction is led by the system, so the system always acts on its own initiative in the interactive procedure. In this approach, the complicated semantic analysis is not involved.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新的中英语音到语音（S2S）翻译范式，它在对话管理的指导下是交互式的。在这种方法中，输入话语首先被预处理，然后由基于模板的翻译器和基于语言间的翻译器串行翻译。对话管理机制（DMM）用于监督交互式分析以消除输入的歧义。交互是由系统主导的，因此系统在交互过程中总是主动行动。在这种方法中，不涉及复杂的语义分析。

title: Chinese Syntactic Parsing Based on Extended GLR Parsing Algorithm with PCFG*
title_en: Chinese Syntactic Parsing Based on Extended GLR Parsing Algorithm with PCFG*
title_zh: 基于PCFG*的扩展GLR解析算法的中文句法解析
abstract_en: This paper presents an extended GLR parsing algorithm with grammar PCFG* that is based on Tomita's GLR parsing algorithm and extends it further.We also define a new grammar-PCFG* that is based on PCFG and assigns not only probability but also frequency associated with each rule.So our syntactic parsing system is implemented based on rule-based approach and statistics approach.Furthermore our experiments are executed in two fields: Chinese base noun phrase identification and full syntactic parsing.And the results of these two fields are compared from three ways.The experiments prove that the extended GLR parsing algorithm with PCFG* is an efficient parsing method and a straightforward way to combine statistical property with rules.The experiment results of these two fields are presented in this paper.
abstract_zh: 本文在Tomita的GLR语法分析算法的基础上提出了一种基于PCFG*的扩展GLR语法分析算法，并对其进行了进一步的扩展。我们还定义了一种新的语法PCFG*，它基于PCFG，不仅分配了每个规则的概率，还分配了与每个规则相关的频率。因此，我们的句法分析系统是基于基于规则的方法和统计方法实现的。此外，我们的实验在两个领域进行：中文基本名词短语识别和全句法分析。从三个方面对这两个领域进行了比较。实验证明，带有PCFG*的扩展GLR解析算法是一种高效的解析方法，也是一种将统计特性与规则相结合的直接方法。

title: An improved template-based approach to spoken language translation
title_en: An improved template-based approach to spoken language translation
title_zh: 改进的基于模板的口语翻译方法
abstract_en: In this paper, we describe an improved template-based approach to Chinese-to-English Spoken Language Translation (SLT) and present experimental results. The improved template-based translation approach uses flexible expression format to describe the template condition. The condition of a template may consist of keywords, parts-of-speech and also semantic features, so the input may be matched with a template from shallow level to deep level. In the condition of a template, the distance between two fixed keywords is stretchable, thus some needless words in the input utterances may be skipped in matching operation. And also the translation results of the same template are alterable. The proper results are finally generated according to the specific context. That is, the relation between a template and translated utterance is one-to-n (where, n is an integer and n≥1). The experiments were performed with input of both text transcription and results of speech recognition. The preliminary experimental results have proven the approach is practical. 1.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们描述了一种改进的基于模板的汉英口语翻译（SLT）方法并展示了实验结果。改进的基于模板的翻译方法使用灵活的表达格式来描述模板条件。模板的条件可以由关键词、词性以及语义特征组成，因此输入可以与模板进行由浅层到深层的匹配。在模板的情况下，两个固定关键词之间的距离是可拉伸的，因此在匹配操作中可以跳过输入话语中的一些不必要的单词。并且同一模板的翻译结果是可以改变的。最终根据具体情况生成正确的结果...

title_en: Chinese Generation in a Spoken Dialogue Translation System
title_zh: 口语翻译系统中的汉语生成
abstract_en: A Chinese generation module in a speech to speech dialogue translation system is presented here. The input of the generation module is the underspecified semantic representation. Its design is strongly influenced by the underspecification of the inputs and the necessity of real-time and robust processing. We design an efficient generation system comprising a task-oriented microplanner and a general surface realization module for Chinese. The microplanner performs the lexical and syntactic choice and makes inferences from the input and domain knowledge. The output of the microplanner is fully instantiated. This enables the surface realizer to traverse the input in a top-down, depth-first fashion, which in turn speeds the whole generation procedure. The surface realizer also combines the template method and deep generation technology in the same formalism. Preliminary results are also presented in this paper.
abstract_zh: 这里提出了语音对话翻译系统中的中文生成模块。生成模块的输入是未指定的语义表示。其设计受到输入规格不足以及实时和鲁棒处理的必要性的强烈影响。我们设计了一个高效的生成系统，包括一个面向任务的微规划器和一个通用的中文表面实现模块。微观规划器执行词汇和句法选择，并根据输入和领域知识进行推断。微规划器的输出已完全实例化。这使得表面实现器能够以自上而下、深度优先的方式遍历输入，从而加速整个生成过程...
